title: Mahdi E-Portfolio 2026
tagline: Production-grade developer portfolio with live CMS, AI twin, and real-time content
description: A full-stack portfolio platform built to demonstrate modern web architecture — not a static template. Every section is CMS-driven, content updates without redeploys, and visitors can interact with an AI twin grounded in live professional data.
highlights: Next.js App Router with server components and route-group architecture
Embedded Sanity Studio with live preview and draft mode
OpenAI ChatKit AI twin with agent workflows, guardrails, and rate limiting
Deployed on Vercel with Upstash Redis for chat persistence

title: Headless CMS with Sanity
tagline: Schema-driven content platform with live reads, visual editing, and structured authoring
description: A complete Sanity integration powering every portfolio section — profile, experience, projects, services, blog, and contact submissions. Editors get a tailored Studio with singleton documents, filtered views, and presentation-mode preview.
highlights: 12+ custom document schemas with singleton patterns for profile and site settings
GROQ queries with defineQuery + sanityFetch for type-safe server reads
SanityLive websocket subscription for real-time content updates
Presentation tool + draft mode for WYSIWYG preview before publish

title: AI Portfolio Twin (ChatKit)
tagline: Agentic AI chat grounded in live portfolio data with guardrails and multi-tone responses
description: An OpenAI ChatKit integration that lets visitors ask questions about my work, skills, and experience. The backend runs a multi-agent workflow — topic filtering, moderation, guardrails, and a portfolio-aware AI twin — with context pulled fresh from Sanity on every message.
highlights: OpenAI Agents SDK workflow with topic filter, moderator, and guardrails
Live CMS context injection from GROQ queries (profile, experience, projects, skills)
Redis-backed thread persistence and IP + guest rate limiting via Upstash
Three conversation tones (Crisp, Clear, Chatty) selectable in the ChatKit UI
